launcher.release_notes:
cx-labs-launcher: 0.11.1 — Check runs in the background, per-row status badges, Cancel + View results (#216)

Before: clicking Check locked the UI behind a modal that said "takes up to
a minute" but could actually hold the user hostage for up to ~29 min on
scenarios with the longest DoD polls (scenario 013). No way to cancel
once started, no way to run another scenario in parallel.

After: Check kicks off a background task that returns from the IPC
immediately. Each scenario row shows its own verify state badge, with
icons for every stage:
  • idle, DoD present       → ✓ Check (clickable when deployed+healthy)
  • running                 → ⏳ Checking · mm:ss + ⊘ Cancel
  • done, outcome=success   → ✓ Last check passed  + 👁 View + ×
  • done, outcome=failure   → ✗ Last check failed  + 👁 View + ×
  • done, outcome=incomplete→ ⚠ Last check incomplete + 👁 View + ×
  • done, outcome=cancelled → ⊘ Last check cancelled + 👁 View + ×
User can start another scenario's Check in parallel, deploy / remove
other scenarios, switch targets, or close the modal entirely — the
job keeps running.

Rust side:
- New `verify_jobs` module holding a VerifyJobManager (HashMap keyed by
  scenario_id) with per-job cancel channels.
- `start_verify` validates the request, inserts a pending entry, spawns
  the long-running work on a tokio task, returns Ok(()) immediately.
- Background task races child.wait() against the cancel oneshot in a
  single select! — natural exit drains output and emits the audit event;
  cancel starts_kill, waits for the zombie, and emits an audit event
  with outcome:"cancelled" + subject.cancelled:true carrying partial
  stdout. Nothing is ever silently dropped.
- `verify_jobs_snapshot` returns everything in one struct for the
  frontend poll; `verify_job_result` returns one job's full stdout for
  the View modal; `cancel_verify` drops the cancel sender;
  `clear_verify_result` removes Done entries so the UI stops showing
  "last check" state.

Frontend side:
- 2 s poll of verify_jobs_snapshot mirrors state into a local Map and
  re-renders trainings. mm:ss elapsed badge counts up live without
  per-row timers.
- runVerify in the modal now calls start_verify + closes the modal
  immediately + toasts "Check started in background".
- openVerifyResultModal fetches the stdout on demand (not pushed through
  every poll cycle) and shows it in the existing results stage.
- New row actions: view-verify, cancel-verify, dismiss-verify.
- Running-stage modal copy updated to reflect it's rarely shown now
  (closed immediately on kickoff).

Audit stream:
- scenario.verify event now carries subject.cancelled:true for user
  cancellations, so dashboards can trivially distinguish "trainee gave
  up after N minutes" from "ran to completion but failed".
- All other audit fields (check_count, ai_review.status, duration_ms)
  unchanged from v0.11.0.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
